title: PMSM Current Reference Generator
text: Permanent magnet synchronous machine current reference generator, 3 inputs, 3 outputs, {Current references} sets Current reference strategy Zero d-axis; {Nominal dc-link voltage (V)} sets the rated DC voltage, {Maximum power (W)} sets the rated power, {Maximum torque (N*m)} sets the rated torque, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time, {Mechanical speed vector, wMechanical (rpm)} sets the rotor speed lookup vector, {Torque reference vector, TqRef (N*m)} sets the torque reference lookup vector, {DC-link voltage vector, Vdc (V)} sets the dC-link voltage lookup vector, {D-axis current reference matrix, id(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc) (A)} sets the reference d-axis current values zeros, {Q-axis current reference matrix, iq(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc) (A)} sets the reference q-axis current values zeros, {PWM method} sets the pulse width modulation method SVM: space vector, {Modulation factor}, {Number of pole pairs} sets the pole pairs, {Permanent magnet flux linkage (Wb)} sets the pM Flux Linkage, {D-axis inductance (H)} sets the inductance of d-axis, {Q-axis inductance (H)} sets the inductance of q-axis and {Stator resistance (Ohm)} sets the resistance of stator. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Nominal dc-link voltage (V)
params.values: Rated DC voltage 300 V (default) | positive number

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Block sample time -1 (default) | -1 or positive number

params.name: Current references
params.values: Current reference strategy Zero d-axis control (default) | Lookup-table based | Automatically generated lookup-table

params.name: Mechanical speed vector, wMechanical (rpm)
params.values: Rotor speed lookup vector [0, 3000] rpm (default) | positive monotonically increasing vector

params.name: Torque reference vector, TqRef (N*m)
params.values: Torque reference lookup vector [-100, 0, 100] N*m (default) | positive monotonically increasing vector

params.name: DC-link voltage vector, Vdc (V)
params.values: DC-link voltage lookup vector [300, 350] V (default) | positive monotonically increasing vector

params.name: D-axis current reference matrix, id(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc) (A)
params.values: Reference d-axis current values zeros(2,3,2) A (default) | real matrix

params.name: Q-axis current reference matrix, iq(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc) (A)
params.values: Reference q-axis current values zeros(2,3,2) A (default) | real matrix

params.name: PWM method
params.values: Pulse width modulation method SVM: space vector modulation (default) | SPWM: sinusoidal PWM

params.name: Permanent magnet flux linkage (Wb)
params.values: PM Flux Linkage 0.04 Wb (default) | positive scalar
